# AxcUIKit-TypeScript

> Focused React and TypeScript editors for query filters, condition and decision rules, and JSON values and parameters.

Install the published package with `npm install @axclogo/uikit`. Use a pinned Git commit only to test an unpublished change. The package has explicit component subpaths and intentionally has no root entry.

## Condition

- `@axclogo/uikit/condition` exports `AxcCondition`, `AxcConditionAssist`, `AxcConditionSimulator`, `AxcDecision` and `AxcDecisionAssist`.
- Use `@axclogo/uikit/condition/core` for the React-free parser, schema, prompt and locale helpers. Call `parseCondition(value, { fields })` before saving, or use `validateCondition` for structured issues.
- Import `@axclogo/uikit/condition/styles.css`. Use `AxcUIProvider` to supply native-equivalent controls and a locale.
- The host evaluates rules, calls models, and persists data. `AxcConditionSimulator` calls the compatible `@axclogo/eval` function supplied by the host; UIKit does not bundle an evaluator or WASM.

## JSON Editor

- `@axclogo/uikit/json-editor` exports `ParamObjectEditor`, `JsonObjectEditor` and `JsonEditorProvider`.
- `JsonObjectEditor` uses explicit value and text variants. Invalid JSON stays as text. `ParamObjectEditor` edits any JSON value with recursive field metadata, host file controls and controlled root-property toggles.
- Use `@axclogo/uikit/json-editor/core` for `parseJsonValue`, `parseJsonContent`, and `jsonSchemaToField` (expanded draft 2020-12 subset). Import `@axclogo/uikit/json-editor/styles.css` for styles.
- Use `@axclogo/uikit/json-editor/codemirror` for the optional CodeMirror source-editor slot.

## Tables and graphs

- `@axclogo/uikit/table` provides BaseTable, DataTable, DataTreeTable, DataAnalysisTable, DataCrudTable and TableUIProvider. Supply rowKey and import `@axclogo/uikit/table/styles.css`. Analysis fields are independent of visible columns.
- `@axclogo/uikit/graph/core` validates relation data. `@axclogo/uikit/graph` exports RelationGraph (G6), GraphWorkbench (React Flow with Dagre layout), workspace and editor components. Supply the corresponding peers and styles documented in the [graph guide](./packages/graph/README.md).

Drawer exposes a native modal through `@axclogo/uikit/drawer` and its explicit stylesheet. CodeMirror view creation belongs to `@axclogo/uikit/code-editor`. Only the optional JSON source adapter loads that view and the JSON language.

## Decision plugins

- `@axclogo/uikit/decision-plugins` exports PluginDecisionEditor, builtinDecisionPlugins, runPluginDecision and PluginTextAssist. Import its stylesheet and Condition styles. Eval 0.4 supplies validation, JSONPath mapping, two-phase execution and evidence; UIKit does not bundle WASM.
- A plugin plan contains an optional precondition, one plugin and a mandatory postcondition. Built-ins are AI, model, JavaScript, HTTP and script. Model loading, resource catalogs and stored scripts remain host-owned. Missing services remain unavailable.
- `AxcAssistAction` in the Condition entry is a developer-enabled draft/preview/adopt primitive reusable by custom plugins. AI assistance is independent of runtime AI decisions.
- [Plugin contract](./packages/decision-plugins/README.md)
